ipa.financial_contracts.eti_option.Definition

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.eti_option.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    *,
    underlying_definition: EtiUnderlyingDefinition = None,
    pricing_parameters: PricingParameters = None,
    instrument_tag: str = None,
    strike: float = None,
    buy_sell: BuySell | str = None,
    call_put: CallPut | str = None,
    exercise_style: ExerciseStyle | str = None,
    end_date: str = None,
    asian_definition: EtiFixingInfo = None,
    barrier_definition: EtiBarrierDefinition = None,
    binary_definition: EtiBinaryDefinition = None,
    cbbc_definition: EtiCbbcDefinition = None,
    instrument_code: str = None,
    lot_size: float = None,
    deal_contract: int = None,
    end_date_time: str = None,
    time_zone_offset: int = None,
    fields: OptStrStrs = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
underlying_definition EtiUnderlyingDefinition No None Details of the underlying. Can be used to override some data of the underlying.
pricing_parameters PricingParameters No None The pricing parameters to apply to this instrument. Optional. If pricing parameters are not provided at this level parameters defined globally at the request level are used. If no pricing parameters are provided globally default values apply.
instrument_tag str No None User defined string to identify the instrument.It can be used to link output results to the instrument definition. Only alphabetic, numeric and '- _.#=@' characters are supported. Optional.
strike float No None strike of the option
buy_sell BuySell | str No None The side of the deal.
call_put CallPut | str No None Tells if the option is a call or a put.
exercise_style ExerciseStyle | str No None EURO or AMER
end_date str No None Expiry date of the option
asian_definition EtiFixingInfo No None Fixing details for asian options
barrier_definition EtiBarrierDefinition No None Details for barrier option.
binary_definition EtiBinaryDefinition No None Details for binary option.
cbbc_definition EtiCbbcDefinition No None Details for CBBC (Call Bear/Bull Contract) option.
instrument_code str No None An option RIC that is used to retrieve the description of the EtiOptionDefinition contract. Optional.If null, the instrument_code of underlying_definition must be provided.
lot_size float No None The lot size. It is the number of options bought or sold in one transaction.
deal_contract int No None deal_contract. It is the number of contracts bought or sold in the deal.
end_date_time str No None Expiry date time of the option
time_zone_offset int No None
fields OptStrStrs No None Contains the list of Analytics that the quantitative analytic service will compute.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters

get_stream

Parameter Type Required Default Description

Example

import lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts as ldf
definition = ldf.eti_option.Definition(
   instrument_code="FCHI560000L1.p",
   fields=[
       "MarketValueInDealCcy",
       "DeltaPercent",
       "GammaPercent",
       "RhoPercent",
       "ThetaPercent",
       "VegaPercent",
       "ErrorCode",
       "ErrorMessage",
   ],
)
response = definition.get_data()

# Using get_stream

stream = definition.get_stream()

Related types

CallPut

Name Value Description
CallPut.CALL 'CALL' the right to buy the underlying asset,
CallPut.NONE 'None'
CallPut.PUT 'PUT' the right to sell the underlying asset. optional. if instrumentcode of listed eti option is defined, the value comes from the instrument reference data.

ExerciseStyle

Name Value Description
ExerciseStyle.AMER 'AMER' the owner has the right to exercise on any date before the option expires,
ExerciseStyle.BERM 'BERM' the owner has the right to exercise on any of several specified dates before the option expires. all exercise styles may not apply to certain option types. optional. if instrumentcode of listed eti option is defined, the value comes from the instrument reference data,
ExerciseStyle.EURO 'EURO' the owner has the right to exercise only on enddate.
